int decode(char *p,int n,char *q){
  int size=0;

      while(h>8191)h=h-8192;
      old=head[h];
      head[h]=i;
      if(old>0-1&&i-old<(2*32768)){

      lit=0;
      if(at+3>FILEMAX)return -1;
      q[at]=128+count-3;
      dist=i-old;

      while(dist>255){

        lit=0;
      }

  }

  return at;
}

#include "lz"
int native(char *name,int dest){
  int k=find(name);
  int n=0;
  int stored=0;
  int i=0;
  char *p=0;
  char *q=(char *)LOADBUF;
  char *d=(char *)dest;
  if(dest!=COMPILER&&dest!=USER&&dest!=APP&&dest!=SHELL)return 0;
  if(!k||length(k)<8)return 0;
  p=bytes(k);
  stored=length(k);
  if(u32(p)==EXEZ){
    stored=lzdecode(p+4,stored-4,q);
    if(stored<8)return 0;
  }
  else{
    if(stored>CODEMAX+4)return 0;
    while(i<stored){
      q[i]=p[i];
      i++;
    }
  }
  n=u32(q);
  if(n<4||n>CODEMAX||stored!=n+4||align4(n)!=n)return 0;
  i=0;
  while(i<n){
    d[i]=q[i+4];
    i++;
  }
  return n;
}

#include "runtime"
int main(int ac,char **av){
  char *p=(char *)INPUT;
  int n=0;
  int i=0;
  int f=0;
  int done=0;
  int v=31;
  int total=0;
  if(ac==3){
    i=0;
    while(av[2][i]){
      total=total*10+av[2][i]-48;
      i++;
    }
    if(total<0||total>FILEMAX)return 2;
    f=open(av[1],577);
    if(f<0)return 1;
    while(done<total){
      n=total-done;
      if(n>512)n=512;
      i=0;
      while(i<n){
        p[i]=v;
        v=v+17;
        if(v>255)v=v-256;
        i++;
      }
      if(write(f,p,n)!=n)return 1;
      done=done+n;
    }
    return close(f);
  }
  while(1){
    n=read(0,p,512);
    if(n<0)return 1;
    if(!n)break;
    i=0;
    while(i<n){
      if(p[i]==255)p[i]=0;
      else p[i]++;
      i++;
    }
    if(write(1,p,n)!=n)return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}

The export omitted the legacy format word at cache offset 4096. That word selects the 24-slot, 32 KiB format; zero caused cold boot to reinterpret the disk as the older 16-slot, 8 KiB format. The exporter now writes it.

The current environment has passed the large-source/code, binary-pipeline, and preservation tests. I’m addressing aggregate storage headroom before the clean rebuilds so ordinary project work won’t depend on deleting or archiving sources.
